metadata.title: Inferxe Filtered & Curated GPU Knowledge Base
metadata.description: Cleaned, high-signal technical dataset compiled from verified Inferxe website modules, DPR, and technical documentation with all synthetic bloat removed.

advanced_technical_concepts.summary: The Roofline Model provides an intuitive performance model used to bind floating-point performance against memory bandwidth. It characterizes whether an LLM inference workload is memory bandwidth-bound (such as autoregressive token generation/decode where arithmetic intensity is low) or compute-bound (such as prompt prefill with large batch sizes where tensor cores are saturated).
advanced_technical_concepts.application_to_inferxe: Helps users determine whether upgrading to HBM3e (H200/B200 with up to 8 TB/s) is necessary vs PCIe GDDR6 based on prompt-to-decode ratio.

advanced_technical_concepts.summary: FlashAttention is an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that tiles the input to compute softmax incrementally without materializing the large intermediate N×N attention matrix in slow GPU High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). By fusing operations and keeping data in fast on-chip SRAM, it achieves 2–4× faster attention computation with linear memory scaling with respect to sequence length.
advanced_technical_concepts.application_to_inferxe: Integrated into vLLM serving backends across all provisioned GPUs on Inferxe.

advanced_technical_concepts.summary: NVLink provides high-bandwidth, direct GPU-to-GPU interconnect bypassing the system CPU and PCIe root complex. NVLink 4 on Hopper delivers 900 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth per GPU, and NVLink 5 on Blackwell reaches 1,800 GB/s, compared to just 64–128 GB/s on PCIe Gen4/Gen5. This 7x–14x bandwidth leap is critical for Tensor Parallelism (TP) all-reduce synchronization.
advanced_technical_concepts.application_to_inferxe: Determines when multi-GPU clusters require SXM5/NVLink instances rather than lower-cost PCIe cards.

advanced_technical_concepts.summary: Post-training quantization reduces parameter bit-width. FP8 (supported natively on Ada Lovelace, Hopper, and Blackwell) preserves dynamic range via E4M3/E5M2 formats with negligible perplexity degradation (<0.1%) while cutting VRAM in half. AWQ (Activation-aware Weight Quantization) protects the 1% salient weights in INT4, allowing 70B models to fit within 40 GB VRAM with minimal quality loss.
advanced_technical_concepts.application_to_inferxe: Enables customers on limited budgets to run 70B models on a single L40S (48 GB) or 14B models on an L4 (24 GB).

advanced_technical_concepts.concept: Data Sovereignty & DPDP Compliance in India
advanced_technical_concepts.summary: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and MeitY cloud security empanelment, enterprise AI systems handling domestic user data must maintain verifiable geographic residency. Inferxe infrastructure resides exclusively in Tier-IV facilities in Mumbai (ap-south-1) and Noida, guaranteeing zero cross-border egress for prompts, weights, and telemetry.
advanced_technical_concepts.application_to_inferxe: Guarantees Indian sovereign compliance for government, banking, healthcare, and enterprise workloads.

developer_code_examples.python_openai_sdk:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.inferxe.com/v1",
    api_key="ix_live_your_api_key_here"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Explain NVLink interconnects."}
    ],
    temperature=0.7,
    stream=True
)

for chunk in response:
    content = chunk.choices[0].delta.content or ""
    print(content, end="", flush=True)
